name: SuperMAG — dark matter analysis
full_name: SuperMAG global magnetometer network dark-matter analysis
summary: Direct searches for ultralight dark-matter fields using global geomagnetic archives, rather than a single detector purpose-built for dark matter.
detection_principle: Correlated oscillating magnetic fields and their characteristic spatial patterns are sought at stations on Earth's surface, treating Earth, its ionosphere and geomagnetic field as an axion or dark-photon conversion system.

status.label: Published experimental record; current overall operating status unverified
status.evidence: 2024 sources support the phase recorded here, rather than a real-time status of the entire project as of the access date.

timeline.event: Search for ultralight dark matter in the SuperMAG high-fidelity dataset

collaboration.name: SuperMAG — dark matter analysis Collaboration / project team
lead_institutions: SuperMAG network; see the paper for analysis-author affiliations
collaboration.participants_note: Only documented principal institutions are listed; full author and affiliation lists are in the sources. Collaborating-institution addresses are not substituted for detector locations.

results.summary: No robust dark-photon or axion candidates; corresponding parameter limits were set.

science_scope: Directly searches for Galactic-halo axions, axionlike particles or other ultralight dark matter. Limits depend on assumed local density, velocity distribution and coupling models; separate scanned mass intervals do not amount to exclusion of the entire range.
